title: loop step config
description: Bounded back-edge that re-runs an earlier step until a condition holds, optionally injecting a corrective turn and tighter sampling on every retry; the exit edge is the envelope next_step.

loopback_step.description: Step to jump back to while the condition does not hold.

fallback_step.description: Step taken when max_iterations is reached; the envelope next_step when unset.

max_iterations.description: Hard ceiling on retries; must be positive.

loopback_message.description: Message appended to the conversation on every loop-back, never on exit or fallback.

role.description: Chat role of the injected message; unknown values fall back to user.

content.description: Jinja template rendered against the pipeline context at loop-back time; a render failure or empty result skips the injection.

retry_sampling_params.description: Sampling override applied to infer steps on the retry edge only and cleared on exit and on fallback.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate; only positive values are applied.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; 0 is greedy and a negative value is ignored.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability; only positive values are applied.

stop.description: Accepted by the codec but not applied on the retry edge.

condition.description: Exit condition evaluated over a context field; the loop exits through next_step when it holds.

input_field.description: Flat context key to evaluate; score conditions also read <input_field>.score.

match_value.description: Reference for equals, contains and label_equals; bare YAML booleans are normalised to YES or NO.
